title: Insider deletes file-share backups
narrative: A departing engineer uses a standing platform-admin role at 06:00 UTC to delete all file-share recovery points, which have no isolated copy. At 08:30 UTC the engineer wipes the file share. The HR portal relies on the file share and is affected too.

injections.description: Recovery points deleted using governance-bypass permission held by platform-admin.

recommended_actions: Create an isolated copy of the file share
